entities.summary: Gordon Eugene "Gordy" Christian was an American ice hockey player. He played with the University of North Dakota from 1947 to 1950, tying for scoring leader on the team in both the 1947–48 and 1948–49 seasons. He was a member of United States national team that won the silver medal at thr 1956 Winter Olympics.
